Large, non-enhancing, infiltrative tumors are highly characteristic of the IDH-mutant phenotype. In contrast, IDH-wildtype gliomas in this age group are typically glioblastomas, which almost always demonstrate avid enhancement and/or central necrosis. The frontal lobe location is also consistent with an IDH-mutant tumor. The evidence strongly points towards an IDH-mutant glioma.
